//: Package files the site serves, by served path -> source path (refactor PKG-9). A key ending in / is a directory (every file under it); any other key is ONE file, served at exactly that path. scripts/build/site.mjs copies them into dist/ at the served path (a package file wins over any file at that path), and the dev servers (scripts/dev/test-server.py, tools/dev-site/server.mjs, scripts/dev/dev-server.mjs) and the cache-token stamps read them through it. Served URLs do not change. app/src/ carries the two module workers the map app starts by URL; src/map/ is served only because src/ was. The map modules that were src/ files (ui-controller.js, data-service.js, the catalogue and the rest; rf9-mapapp, 12 Nov 2026) are packages/map/src/ files still served at their old /src/ paths: one key per file and src/catalogue/, listed BEFORE src/map/, because the first key whose source holds a file gives its served path (tests/unit/map-served-paths.test.mjs pins every one). src/libs/ (vendored) is still the root src/ folder. pkg/ (owner-approved 11 Nov 2026, Elections arch audit P3) is an ALLOWLIST of single files, never a directory: the pure package modules a served, unbundled page may import, at /pkg/<the path under packages/>, so their relative imports of each other keep working. Every entry must be pure browser code whose own imports are listed too; tests/unit/served-pkg.test.mjs lists exactly what is served, and packages/README.md ('Served package modules') says how a page adopts one.
